article.title: “I’d like the genetically modified organic food, please”
article.excerpt: It turns out that much of the organic food in the U.K. has genetically modified components, usually soya: Transgenic soya was found in ten of 25 organic or health food products tested by Mark Partridge and Denis Murphy, biotechnology researchers at the University of Glamorgan in Pontypridd, Wales.
